snippet.title: SornHack — Hack the Game Itself | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Most games have rules. SornHack lets you rewrite them.

What if you could freeze your health, manipulate gravity, bypass security systems, or change the instructions controlling the game itself?

Welcome to SornHack — a first-person reverse-engineering puzzle game where hacking isn't cheating. It's the gameplay.

Explore futuristic cyber laboratories, fight enemies, investigate simulated memory, and discover how systems work from the inside.

Learn the tools. Understand the system. Break the rules.

🔹 Scan, edit, and freeze memory values with SornScan
🔹 Trace and modify instructions with SornTrace
🔹 Discover pointers and dynamic memory addresses
🔹 Manipulate physics, security systems, and AI behavior
🔹 Combine hacking techniques with FPS combat
🔹 Learn through guided labs, then solve challenges your own way

You don't need to be a reverse engineer to begin. The early labs teach you the fundamentals, while later challenges let you experiment and find your own solutions.

Your knowledge is your greatest weapon.

🎮 Play SornHack on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pokpong.sornhack

🎮 Play SornHack on MacOS:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sornhack-reverse-engineering/id6825612432?mt=12

Developed by Pokpong Limpaphan — an independent game developer from Thailand.

🇹🇭 เกี่ยวกับเกม

SornHack เกม FPS Puzzle แนว Reverse Engineering ที่ให้คุณใช้เครื่องมือแบบ Cheat Engine เพื่อแก้ไขค่า Memory, Freeze, ค้นหา Pointer และแก้ Instruction เพื่อเปลี่ยนกฎของเกม

เริ่มต้นจากด่านสอนพื้นฐาน ก่อนนำความรู้ไปแก้ปริศนาและต่อสู้ด้วยวิธีของคุณเอง

SornHack — Break the Rules.

#SornHack #IndieGame #HackingGame
